# thetipoff

> thetipoff publishes NBA predictions for every player and game, set against the bookmaker lines, with a public track record of how accurate they are.

thetipoff (thetipoff.com.au) models every NBA player and game each night: a prediction for points, rebounds, assists, threes and the combined markets, with the range the result lands inside 80% of the time, set against the bookmakers' player prop lines in decimal odds. Game trends give every team's record against the spread and over/under by situation and date range, and each team's game log. Times are Australian eastern time (AEDT/AEST). Just the Tip is the single biggest edge each night, chosen by the model, never by a person, and graded on closing-line value. Accuracy is published openly: average error by market and how often results land inside the ranges.

Key terms: "edge" is our probability minus the bookmaker's probability with its margin removed. "CLV" (closing-line value) is the price we posted against the bookmaker's fair price at tip-off. Predictions are statistical estimates, not betting advice. 18+. Gamble responsibly: Gambling Help Online, 1800 858 858.

## Pages

- [NBA predictions today](https://thetipoff.com.au/predictions.html): every player tonight, our prediction against the bookmaker line, with the edge
- [Just the Tip](https://thetipoff.com.au/tip.html): the night's biggest edge, on the record, and every tip since
- [NBA game trends](https://thetipoff.com.au/games.html): against the spread and over/under by situation and date range, with tonight's games and the bookmaker lines
- [Nightly previews](https://thetipoff.com.au/previews/): one page per night, the games, the biggest edges, who's out and who benefits
- [Team pages](https://thetipoff.com.au/teams/): each team's game log with the line, cover, total and over/under, and with or without any player
- [Player props and stats](https://thetipoff.com.au/players/): every player's predictions, season averages and recent games
- [Track record](https://thetipoff.com.au/track-record.html): how accurate the predictions are
- [NBA games today in Australian time](https://thetipoff.com.au/schedule.html)

## Data

- [Open data](https://thetipoff.com.au/api.html): the JSON files behind the site, with every field described
- [Tonight's player predictions (JSON)](https://thetipoff.com.au/data/projections.json)
- [Tonight's game predictions (JSON)](https://thetipoff.com.au/data/games.json)
- [Just the Tip record (JSON)](https://thetipoff.com.au/data/tips.json)
- [Track record (JSON)](https://thetipoff.com.au/data/track_record.json)
